articles.title: Ledger’s answer to wallet tampering costs $849 and ships next year
articles.snippet: Ledger’s new Atom combines crypto wallet security with everyday apps and is expected to ship in summer 2027 as the company investigates tampered wallets sold in Asia.

articles.title: GTA 6 Trailer Features Meme Coin—And Solana Copycat Soars 2,900%
articles.snippet: Rockstar released the launch trailer for GTA VI, revealing a potential meme coin in the upcoming game and sending degens wild.
